candidates.angle: The wish-fulfilling cow represents the highest form of abundance
candidates.evidence: धेनूनामस्मि कामधुक् (among cows I am the wish-fulfilling cow)

candidates.angle: Krishna includes the force of desire in his list of divine forms
candidates.evidence: प्रजनश्चास्मि कन्दर्पः (I am the cause of procreation, and Kandarpa)

candidates.angle: The thunderbolt, Vasuki, and the force of procreation are all named here
candidates.evidence: आयुधानामहं वज्रं ... सर्पाणामस्मि वासुकिः ... प्रजनश्चास्मि कन्दर्पः

angle_en: Desire is one of Krishna's divine forms
angle_hi: इच्छा भी श्रीकृष्ण के दिव्य रूपों में से एक है

en.intro: The battlefield of Kurukshetra is a stage for the divine. Listen to how Krishna names his presence in the very forces of creation.
en.notice: Notice how Krishna includes the wish-fulfilling cow and the force of procreation in his list, placing desire itself among his divine forms.
en.next: Krishna continues naming the highest beings in creation, moving from Vasuki to Varuna, the lord of the waters.
en.meaning: Among weapons, I am the thunderbolt; among cows, I am the wish-fulfilling cow. I am the cause of procreation, and among serpents, I am Vasuki.

hi.meaning: आयुधोंमें वज्र और धेनुओंमें कामधेनु मैं हूँ । सन्तानउत्पत्तिका हेतु कामदेव मैं हूँ और सर्पोंमें वासुकि मैं हूँ ॥
hi.notice: ध्यान दीजिए कि श्रीकृष्ण अपनी सूची में कामधेनु और प्रजननादि को शामिल करते हैं, और इस प्रकार इच्छा को भी अपने दिव्य रूपों में रखते हैं।
hi.next: श्रीकृष्ण सृष्टि के सबसे बड़े प्राणियों का नाम लेना जारी रखते हैं, वासुकि से लेकर वरुण तक।

en.intro: The battlefield of Kurukshetra is a stage for the divine. Listen to how Krishna names his presence in the very forces of creation.
en.body: Among weapons, I am the thunderbolt; among cows, I am the wish-fulfilling cow. I am the cause of procreation, and among serpents, I am Vasuki. Notice how Krishna includes the wish-fulfilling cow and the force of procreation in his list, placing desire itself among his divine forms. Krishna continues naming the highest beings in creation, moving from Vasuki to Varuna, the lord of the waters.

hi.body: आयुधोंमें वज्र और धेनुओंमें कामधेनु मैं हूँ । सन्तानउत्पत्तिका हेतु कामदेव मैं हूँ और सर्पोंमें वासुकि मैं हूँ ॥ ध्यान दीजिए कि श्रीकृष्ण अपनी सूची में कामधेनु और प्रजननादि को शामिल करते हैं, और इस प्रकार इच्छा को भी अपने दिव्य रूपों में रखते हैं। श्रीकृष्ण सृष्टि के सबसे बड़े प्राणियों का नाम लेना जारी रखते हैं, वासुकि से लेकर वरुण तक।

issues: en.intro: banned phrase "not just a clash of armies, but"

meaning_changed: "शस्त्रों में वज्र, गायों में कामधेनु, सन्तानोत्पत्ति का हेतु कामदेव और सर्पों में वासुकि मैं हूँ।" (The Hindi meaning changes the Sanskrit 'प्रजनः' (the cause/force of procreation) to 'कामदेव' (the god of love). While Kandarpa (Kandarpa) is mentioned in the source as the 'cause of procreation', the Hindi translation replaces the general concept of procreative force with a specific deity, altering the meaning.)

unsupported: "ध्यान दीजिए कि श्रीकृष्ण, जो अर्जुन को ज्ञान देने वाले हैं" (The source text does not mention or support that Krishna is about to give knowledge to Arjuna in this specific verse. This is an unsupported factual claim inserted into the notice.)

meaning_changed: "शस्त्रों में वज्र, गायों में कामधेनु, प्रजननादि और सर्पों में वासुकि मैं हूँ।" (The Hindi meaning drops the explicit 'I am' (मैं हूँ) for 'Among weapons, I am the thunderbolt' and 'among cows, I am the wish-fulfilling cow', and completely omits the 'I am' for 'I am the cause of procreation'. It also replaces 'कामधेनु' (the wish-fulfilling cow) with 'कामधेनु', which is a different entity (the wish-fulfilling cow is 'कामधुक्').)

meaning_changed: "शस्त्रों में वज्र, गायों में कामधेनु, प्रजननादि और सर्पों में वासुकि मैं हूँ।" (The Hindi translation uses 'वज्र' (thunderbolt) instead of 'वज्रम्' (the thunderbolt), which drops the definite article and changes the meaning from a specific weapon to a general class. Additionally, it omits 'among cows' (धेनूनाम्) before 'कामधेनु', which changes the meaning from 'among cows, I am the wish-fulfilling cow' to 'among cows, [it is] the wish-fulfilling cow', effectively dropping the 'I am' (अहम् अस्मि) claim for that item.)

meaning_changed: "प्रजननादि" (The Hindi phrase 'प्रजननादि' (procreation, etc.) softens and drops the specific 'cause of procreation' (प्रजनः) from the source. The source explicitly states 'I am the cause of procreation' (प्रजनश्चास्मि), which is a direct identification with the force/urge of procreation, whereas 'प्रजननादि' (procreation, etc.) changes the meaning to a general category.)
